description.en: Teleports a match member to a given field position and facing, by team slot and character ID or number.
Index of the team/side the character belongs to.
Character ID string, or a numeric character index, identifying the member to move.
3-element array [x, z, rotY] with the target field position and Y-axis rotation.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if fewer than 3 arguments were given.
